registered.name: read
registered.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

registered.name: bash
registered.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds. Omitted timeout uses a finite host default (60 seconds unless configured). Explicit longer budgets are preserved. Use binding_ref for selected scientific software; select_environment does not globally activate anything.

registered.name: edit
registered.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

registered.name: write
registered.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

registered.name: grep
registered.description: Search file contents for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 100 matches or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Long lines are truncated to 500 chars.

registered.name: find
registered.description: Search for files by glob pattern. Returns matching file paths relative to the search directory. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 1000 results or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

registered.name: ls
registered.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

registered.name: file_stat
registered.description: 按当前账号权限核对文件路径与元数据。

registered.name: ask_user
registered.description: 询问关键选择并等待真实用户回答；method=editor 可请求多行编辑回答，不猜测答案。

registered.name: update_plan
registered.description: 可选的当前分支工作笔记，不是执行许可或必须产物合同。

registered.name: select_environment
registered.description: 需要外部生信软件时优先调用，先查登记再定位；可一次查询多个 tools。返回 AVAILABLE/UNKNOWN、冲突/失效/注册源错误及真实来源和 binding_ref；未命中不表示服务器未安装。已有适用登记不重复探测。mode=locate 仅在明确 prefix 或已知环境清单做有界定位，单次15秒、request累计60秒，同查询复用结果。命中后 run_command 使用绑定；环境相关 bash 必须显式传 binding_ref，不能依赖全局激活。

registered.name: register_environment
registered.description: 先用 probe_command 验证确切入口再登记已有软件；verification_runs 关联当前请求真实探针回执及辨识输出。写入与查询相同权威，幂等保留多环境。安装工具已自动登记则不重复调用。本工具不执行安装或探针；无 verification_runs 时仅保存声明，source_note/evidence_refs 不能升级为验证事实。

registered.name: inspect_run
registered.description: 查询已有 run_ref 的真实状态；失败作业不等于查询失败。按需用 record=command 读取已记录命令/cwd/环境引用，record=script 和 script_index 读取实际冻结脚本；offset/max_chars 分页，遵守当前请求范围。不触发检查或重跑。

registered.name: wait_run
registered.description: 等待已有作业的有限状态变化；界面心跳不需要模型重复调用。

registered.name: read_run_log
registered.description: 分页读取真实日志；游标是服务返回的原始不透明字符串，完整日志留在原文件。

registered.name: cancel_run
registered.description: 明确取消指定科学作业；与中断当前对话不同。

registered.name: memory_search
registered.description: 按当前历史读取开关和项目 scope 查询长期记忆。

registered.name: memory_read
registered.description: 读取可用来源；关闭历史时不能读取旧项目历史。

registered.name: probe_command
registered.description: 有时限的本地程序核查；保留观察取消，不提供强制只读或网络隔离。默认15秒/64 KiB输出；用户明确检查或QC可用timeout_ms，不设置environment_diagnostic。仅环境故障定点诊断设environment_diagnostic=true，单次15秒、每request累计30秒；正式计算和安装不受诊断短预算影响。

registered.name: run_command
registered.description: 启动本地托管命令并返回 run_ref；保留持久日志、观察、取消与重连对账，无 BioMind 目录或命令审批。支持 shell 或 argv，计划可选。显式 binding_ref/env_name 使用准确目标；否则复用本请求和 scope 的唯一适用绑定，多绑定须明确指定。无绑定且无运行时要求时保持宿主执行。

registered.name: install_tool
registered.description: 提出安装方案并等待原意图确认。验证必须检查目标 prefix 内的准确工具；结构化 executable/python_import/r_package 检查不能由任意 echo 成功替代。安装完成但登记失败时只恢复登记。

registered.name: memory_write
registered.description: 按原策略写 Wiki 或显式偏好；不把偏好当安装授权。

registered.name: maintenance_submit
registered.description: 仅在已启用的记忆维护窗口提交当前证据支持的patch；空operations表示无可保存事实。
